data.title: Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer favors Bitcoin over gold amid sell-off
data.description: Bitcoin and gold both took a hit in the latest market sell-off. According to Fidelity's Jurrien Timmer, only one of them handled it with any grace.Timmer, Fidelity's Director of Global Macro, says he prefers Bitcoin over gold right now. His reasoning is simple: Bitcoin's price measured against gold…
